# BackGen — Backend Project Generator

> Generate production-ready Express.js backend projects in minutes.
> npm: `@ibrahimkhaled19/backgen`
> GitHub: https://github.com/IbrahimKhaled19/BackGen

## Quick Start

```bash
npx @ibrahimkhaled19/backgen init my-api --orm prisma --defaults
cd my-api
npm run dev
```

## MCP Server (AI Integration)

BackGen ships an MCP server that AI agents can use directly:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "backgen": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@ibrahimkhaled19/backgen"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Available Tools

1. **init_project** — Scaffold a new project (name, orm, preset, defaults)
2. **add_plugin** — Install a plugin into an existing project
3. **remove_plugin** — Remove a plugin from a project
4. **generate_resource** — Generate a CRUD resource module
5. **generate_seed** — Generate seed data
6. **generate_factory** — Generate a test factory
7. **doctor** — Check project health
8. **list_plugins** — List available plugins
9. **list_presets** — List available domain presets
10. **project_info** — Read project manifest

## CLI Commands

- `backgen init [name]` — Create project (flags: --orm, --preset, --defaults, --skip-install)
- `backgen add [plugin]` — Install plugin
- `backgen remove [plugin]` — Remove plugin
- `backgen generate resource [name]` — CRUD module
- `backgen generate seed [resource]` — Seed data
- `backgen generate factory [resource]` — Test factory
- `backgen doctor` — Health check
- `backgen upgrade` — Upgrade project templates
- `backgen rollback` — Rollback upgrade
- `backgen sync` — Reconcile manifest with project

## Supported ORMs
- Prisma (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
- Drizzle (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
- Mongoose (MongoDB)

## Available Plugins
- auth: jwt, clerk
- payment: stripe
- storage: s3
- production: ratelimit
- devops: ci-github, dependabot, codeql, docker-registry, release

## Domain Presets
- saas-core (organizations, memberships, RBAC)
- healthcare, ecommerce, crm, lms
